samples.question: The image shows several small square pads of equal size on a plain background, each separated from the others by clear background. Exactly two pads carry a short teal arm attached flush to one of their four sides and sticking outward; a colored pad never carries an arm. Exactly one of those two armed pads also carries a small dark square at its centre, and that is the entry pad. An arm names a direction: from the pad it is attached to, travel in the direction the arm sticks out and stop at the first pad whose centre lies in that direction and on the arm's axis. Start at the entry pad and take its arm; that first hop always lands on the other armed gray pad. Take that pad's arm for the second hop, which always lands on a colored pad. Exactly one orange pad and exactly one purple pad are present. Gray pads without an arm are decoys and mean nothing. Which colored pad does the second hop land on? Answer orange or purple.
